scope: Ordinary range-function preparation uses a local descriptor-position index for full-hash-only duplicate lookup after complete acquisition; original evaluation/error phases, hashes, controls, diagnostics, publication and raw paging remain authoritative.

performance.scope: 6 complete generated instantaneous range reduction queries, both optimized profiles, three repetitions with alternating pair order. Workspace is tracked query memory; elapsed_ns is synthetic query timing, not Agent throughput or process RSS.

limitations: Finite inputs do not prove arbitrary-input equivalence.
Fixture timings and tracked query workspace are not production disk throughput or RSS.
Standalone foreign callers do not qualify a whole foreign Netdata Agent.
Caller ASan/UBSan does not instrument the Rust archive; MSRV is compile-only.
Kind-aware streaming duplicate checks, delayed cleanup and generic merge identities are intentionally retained.
Hash collisions can require repeated probes; other preparation/final replay costs remain, and raw reads are unchanged.
Earlier qualification cohorts preserve their actual source and binary identities.
